title: TapClick
description:
I built TapClick because I've been drumming for a long time and most metronome apps felt bloated, fiddly, or not quite right on the gig. I wanted something simpler and more accurate — easy to read, easy to set, and reliable when it matters.

TapClick is a metronome for iPhone and Apple Watch: tap tempo, setlists, silent-bar training, and custom accents. One-time purchase. No ads, no subscriptions, no account. Works offline.
